subject: English
theme: People who changed the world: Wangari Maathai
status: Original practice content written by Claude Code (Opus 5.5) on 2026-11-06 to mirror the official paper's structure, task types, timing and level. Not copied from БҮТ papers. Teacher review pending. Not used on the website.

tasks.title: Grammar
tasks.instructions: Read the following sentences. Choose the best answer for each gap. /12 x 1 = 12 points/

questions.stem: I usually go to bed ___ midnight ___ weekdays.
questions.explanation: Цагийн тодорхой агшинд (“midnight”) “at”, долоо хоногийн ажлын өдрүүдэд (“weekdays”) өдөр заадаг “on” угтвар үг хэрэглэдэг тул “at / on”.

questions.stem: My cousins ___ in Canada, but they visit us every summer.
questions.explanation: Канадад байнга амьдардаг нь тогтвортой байдал тул одоо энгийн цаг; “My cousins” олон тоо учир “-s”-гүй “live” орох бөгөөд дараагийн “they visit us every summer” ч мөн одоо энгийн цагт байна.

questions.stem: When I was a child, I ___ in the countryside every summer.
questions.explanation: “When I was a child” нь өнгөрсөн үеийг заадаг тул тэр үед зун бүр давтагдаж байсан үйлийг өнгөрсөн энгийн цаг “stayed” илэрхийлнэ; “have stayed” одоотой холбоотой тул тохирохгүй.

questions.stem: Erdene ___ his driving test, so now he can drive alone.
questions.explanation: Шалгалт өгсний үр дүн одоо харагдаж байгаа (“so now he can drive alone”) тул одоо төгссөн цаг; “Erdene” ганц тоо тул “have” биш “has passed”.

questions.stem: We're ___ to the beach on Sunday. Would you like ___ along?
questions.explanation: Далайн эрэг рүү явах нь “on Sunday” гэж товлогдсон тул “We're going” хэлбэр ирээдүйг заана; “Would you like … along?” урилгад инфинитив “to come” орж “going / to come” болно.

questions.stem: The woman ___ lives next door is a famous singer.
questions.explanation: “The woman” хүн бөгөөд тодотгол өгүүлбэрт өгүүлэгдэхүүний үүрэгтэй (“lives next door”) тул харьцангуй төлөөний үг “who” орно; “which” юманд, “whose” эзэмшилд.

questions.stem: I ___ come to your party tomorrow. I have to work, sorry.
questions.explanation: “I have to work” гэсэн шалтгаанаар маргааш очих боломжгүй гэдгийг “can't” (чадахгүй, боломжгүй) илэрхийлнэ; “mustn't” нь хориг, “needn't” нь шаардлагагүй гэсэн утгатай.

questions.stem: My parents made me ___ my room before I went out.
questions.explanation: “make” нь хэн нэгнийг албадан юм хийлгэх утгатай үед хүний дараа “to”-гүй инфинитив авдаг тул “made me clean my room”; “made me to clean” гэвэл алдаа.

questions.stem: Millions of photos ___ on social media every day.
questions.explanation: “Millions of photos” олон тоо бөгөөд зургийг хүмүүс нийтэлдэг тул үйлдэгдэх хэвийн олон тооны хэлбэр “are posted” орно; “every day” нь тогтмол давтагддаг үйлийг заана.

questions.stem: This exercise is ___ than the last one.
questions.explanation: “than the last one” харьцуулах зэрэг шаардана; “-y”-ээр төгссөн “easy” харьцуулах зэрэгт “easier” болдог бөгөөд “much” ялгааг онцолж “much easier” гэнэ; “more easy” гэж хэлдэггүй.

questions.stem: If she ___ the train, she ___ here by six.
questions.explanation: Өгүүлэгдэхүүн “she” учир нөхцөл хэсэгт “-es” дагавартай “catches”, үр дүнгийн хэсэгт “will be” орно; галт тэргэнд суух нь бодит боломж тул 1-р төрлийн нөхцөлт өгүүлбэр: “catches / will be”.

questions.stem: They wanted to know when ___.
questions.explanation: “wanted to know” гэсэн өнгөрсөн цагийн дараа шууд бус асуулт хүүрнэх дараалалтай болж, “will” нь “would” болж ухардаг тул “the exam would start”.

tasks.title: Task 1
tasks.instructions: Read the sentences and choose the best one for each blank. /6 x 2 = 12 points/

questions.stem: She works as a nurse. It's a very demanding ___.
questions.explanation: “She works as a nurse” гэж ажил мэргэжлийг дурдсан тул “a very demanding occupation” (их ачаалалтай мэргэжил) гэж хэлнэ; “salary” цалин, “interview” ярилцлага, “hobby” хобби.

questions.stem: Khongor is very ___. He keeps trying and never stops until the job is finished.
questions.explanation: “He keeps trying and never stops until the job is finished” гэсэн нь бууж өгдөггүй “persistent” (шаргуу, тууштай) зан; “lazy”, “impatient”, “careless” эсрэг санаатай.

questions.stem: Our class went on a(n) ___ to the national history museum.
questions.explanation: Ангиараа музей үзэхээр явсан богино аяллыг “excursion” (танин мэдэхүйн аялал) гэнэ; “expedition” нь урт хугацааны судалгааны аялал, “exhibition” үзэсгэлэн, “emigration” цагаачлал.

questions.stem: I felt ___ when I saw the spider on my bed.
questions.explanation: “when I saw the spider on my bed” (орон дээрээ аалз харахад) айдас төрөх нь ойлгомжтой тул “frightened” (айсан); “delighted” баярласан, “proud” бахархсан, “relaxed” тайвширсан гэсэн утгатай.

questions.stem: The ___ lasted for three years, and many animals died because there was no water.
questions.explanation: Гурван жил үргэлжилж, “there was no water” (ус байгаагүй) учраас олон амьтан үхсэн байгалийн гамшиг бол “drought” (ган); “flood” нь эсрэгээрээ хэт их ус, “blizzard” цасан шуурга.

questions.stem: Don't ___ me! It wasn't my fault.
questions.explanation: “It wasn't my fault” (миний буруу биш) гэсэн нь намайг битгий буруутга гэсэн утга тул “blame” (буруутгах); “praise”, “thank” эерэг утгатай.

tasks.title: Task 2
tasks.instructions: Choose the one that has the similar meaning to the underlined word. /3 x 2 = 6 points/

questions.stem: The museum has a <u>huge</u> collection of dinosaur bones.
questions.explanation: “huge” (асар том) ба “enormous” ижил утгатай; үлэг гүрвэлийн ясны цуглуулга маш том гэсэн санаа бөгөөд “tiny” (өчүүхэн) нь эсрэг утгатай.

questions.stem: Please <u>continue</u> reading from page 20.
questions.explanation: “continue” нь үргэлжлүүлэх гэсэн утгатай бөгөөд ярианы хэлэнд хэлц үйл үг “go on”-оор илэрхийлдэг: “from page 20” гэж 20-р хуудаснаас цааш уншихыг хэлж байна; “stop” эсрэг утгатай.

questions.stem: He <u>refused</u> to answer the question.
questions.explanation: “refused to answer” нь хариулахаас татгалзсан гэсэн утгатай тул “said no”; “agreed” (зөвшөөрсөн) нь эсрэг утгатай.

tasks.title: Task 3
tasks.instructions: Phrasal verbs. Choose the correct particles. /4 x 2 = 8 points/

questions.stem: Please put ___ your coat; it's very cold outside.
questions.explanation: Хувцсаа өмсөхийг “put on” гэдэг бөгөөд “it's very cold outside” гэсэн нь пальтогоо өмсөх шалтгаан; “take off” нь эсрэгээрээ тайлах.

questions.stem: I'll find ___ what time the train leaves.
questions.explanation: “find out” нь мэдээлэл лавлаж мэдэх гэсэн хэлц үйл үг: “what time the train leaves” (галт тэрэг хэдэн цагт явахыг) олж мэдье гэж байна.

questions.stem: Can you fill ___ this application form, please?
questions.explanation: Маягт, анкет бөглөхийг “fill in” гэдэг: “this application form” (энэ өргөдлийн маягт) бөглөхийг хүсэж байна; “fill out” ч мөн адил утгатай.

questions.stem: She grew ___ in a small village near the Selenge River.
questions.explanation: “grow up” нь өсөж том болох гэсэн хэлц үйл үг: тэр “in a small village near the Selenge River” буюу Сэлэнгэ мөрний ойролцоох жижиг тосгонд өссөн.

tasks.title: Task 4
tasks.instructions: Choose the best answer. /2 x 2 = 4 points/

questions.stem: ___ is someone who uses science to design and build machines, bridges or roads.
questions.explanation: Шинжлэх ухааны мэдлэгээр машин, гүүр, зам зохион бүтээж барьдаг хүн бол “An engineer” (инженер); “A mechanic” машин засварладаг, “A carpenter” модоор эдлэл хийдэг.

questions.stem: ___ is someone who chooses and prepares the articles for a newspaper or magazine before it is printed.
questions.explanation: Сонин, сэтгүүлд хэвлэгдэхээс өмнө нийтлэлүүдийг сонгож, засварладаг хүнийг “An editor” (редактор) гэнэ; “A reporter” мэдээ бичдэг, “A printer” хэвлэдэг.

tasks.title: Communication
tasks.instructions: Choose the correct question that goes with the answers. /5 x 2 = 10 points/

questions.stem: My father. We both have curly hair.
questions.explanation: Хариулт “My father” гэж хүн нэрлээд “We both have curly hair” гэж гадаад төрхийн ижил шинжийг дурдсан тул “Who do you look like?” (хэнтэй төстэй вэ); “What's your father like?” бол зан чанар асууна.

questions.stem: Twenty minutes ago.
questions.explanation: “Twenty minutes ago” дахь “ago” нь өнгөрсөн цагийн агшныг заадаг тул кино хэзээ эхэлснийг асуусан “When did the film start?”; “How long is the film?” бол үргэлжлэх хугацаа.

questions.stem: Seven. Three boys and four girls.

options.B: How many grandchildren do you have?

questions.explanation: Хариулт тоогоор (“Seven”) эхэлж, “Three boys and four girls” гэж задалсан тул тоо асуусан “How many grandchildren do you have?”; “How old …?” бол нас асууна.

questions.stem: Since 2015. Before that, we lived in Darkhan.

options.B: When did you move to Darkhan?
options.D: How long have you lived here?

questions.explanation: “Since 2015” нь хэзээнээс хойш гэдгийг хэлж, “Before that, we lived in Darkhan” гэж өмнө нь өөр газар амьдарч байсныг нэмсэн тул одоо төгссөн цагтай “How long have you lived here?” (энд хэр удаж байна вэ) гэсэн асуултын хариулт; “When did you move to Darkhan?” бол Дархан руу нүүсэн тухай асуулт.

questions.stem: For cutting paper.
questions.explanation: “For cutting paper” нь “for” + -ing бүтцээр зориулалтыг заадаг тул “What is it used for?” (юунд хэрэглэдэг вэ) гэсэн асуулт; “Who is it for?” бол хэнд зориулсныг асууна.

tasks.title: Reading
tasks.instructions: Read the article and choose the best answer for the questions. /8 x 2 = 16 points/
tasks.text:
In the early 1970s, Wangari Maathai noticed that something was going wrong in her home country, Kenya. Rivers that she remembered from her childhood were drying up, forests were being cut down, and women in the countryside had to walk farther and farther every day to find firewood and clean water. Many families could no longer grow enough food.

Maathai was not an ordinary woman. She was the first woman in East and Central Africa to earn a doctorate degree, and she taught at the University of Nairobi. She believed that the answer to many of these problems was simple: plant trees. Trees would protect the soil, keep water in the ground and give people wood and fruit.

In 1977 she started the Green Belt Movement. The idea was to pay village women a small amount of money for every young tree they planted that survived. At first, many people laughed at her. Some officials thought that women without education could not do such work. But the women proved them wrong. They collected seeds, grew young trees in small nurseries and planted them across the country.

Maathai's work was not always easy. She often criticised the government when it tried to sell public forests and parks to builders, and she was arrested several times. Yet she never gave up. Over the following decades, the women of the Green Belt Movement planted tens of millions of trees.

In 2004, Maathai became the first African woman to receive the Nobel Peace Prize. Some people were surprised that **it** was given for planting trees. Maathai explained that peace depends on how we share and protect the Earth's resources. She believed that when people plant trees, they also plant hope for the future.

questions.stem: In the 1970s, women in the Kenyan countryside

options.E: had to walk farther to find wood and water.

questions.explanation: 1-р догол мөрөнд “women in the countryside had to walk farther and farther every day to find firewood and clean water” гэж бичсэн; олон гэр бүл хангалттай хүнс тарьж ургуулж чадахаа больсон тул “had plenty of food” гэдэг нь буруу.

questions.stem: Wangari Maathai

options.B: was the first woman in East and Central Africa to earn a doctorate.
options.E: lived in the city all her life.

questions.explanation: 2-р догол мөрөнд “She was the first woman in East and Central Africa to earn a doctorate degree” гэжээ; тэр Найробийн их сургуульд багшилж байсан тул “never went to university” гэдэг нь эхтэй зөрчилдөнө.

questions.stem: Maathai believed that trees would

options.D: protect the soil and keep water in the ground.

questions.explanation: Маатай “Trees would protect the soil, keep water in the ground and give people wood and fruit” гэж итгэдэг байсан тул мод хөрсийг хамгаалж, газрын усыг хадгална гэж үзжээ.

questions.stem: In the Green Belt Movement, women were paid

options.A: for every tree they cut down.
options.C: for every young tree that survived.

questions.explanation: 3-р догол мөрөнд “pay village women a small amount of money for every young tree they planted that survived” гэсэн; бага хэмжээний мөнгийг зөвхөн ургаж үлдсэн суулгац бүрт төлдөг байв.

questions.stem: At first, some officials thought that

options.D: women without education could not do the work.

questions.explanation: “Some officials thought that women without education could not do such work” гэж бичсэн боловч “the women proved them wrong” буюу эмэгтэйчүүд эсрэгээр нь баталсан.

questions.stem: What does "it" in the last paragraph refer to?
questions.explanation: “it was given” (олгогдсон) гэдэг нь шагналд тохирох үйл бөгөөд өмнөх өгүүлбэрт Маатай “the Nobel Peace Prize” хүртсэн гэж бичсэн тул “it” үүнийг заана.

questions.stem: Why was Maathai arrested?

options.B: Because she criticised plans to sell public forests and parks.
options.E: Because she did not pay the women.

questions.explanation: 4-р догол мөрөнд “She often criticised the government when it tried to sell public forests and parks to builders, and she was arrested several times” гэжээ; нийтийн ой, цэцэрлэгт хүрээлэнг зарах оролдлогыг шүүмжилсний улмаас баривчлагдсан.

questions.stem: Maathai thought that peace

options.B: has nothing to do with nature.
options.C: depends on sharing and protecting natural resources.

questions.explanation: Маатай “peace depends on how we share and protect the Earth's resources” гэж тайлбарласан тул энх тайван байгалийн баялгийг хуваалцаж, хамгаалахаас хамаардаг гэж үзжээ.

tasks.instructions: Match the beginnings of the sentences (a-e) with the appropriate endings (1-6). There is one extra ending in column 2. /5 x 1 = 5 points/

items.label: a
items.explanation: “When you press this button” нь товч дарах бүрт ижил үр дүн гардгийг заадаг тул үр дүнгийн хэсэг мөн одоо энгийн цагт байна: “… the machine starts” (машин ажиллаж эхэлнэ).

items.label: b
items.explanation: “were” нь бодит бус одоог (баян биш) заадаг тул үр дүнд “would” бүхий “… I would travel around the world” орно; “I will travel” нь “If I were rich”-тэй хослохгүй.

items.label: c
items.explanation: Мөнгө хураасан зорилгыг “so that” илэрхийлдэг бөгөөд “saved” өнгөрсөн цагт тул “can” нь “could” болж “… she could buy a new laptop” гэж нийлнэ.

items.label: d
items.explanation: “Nobody knew” гэсний дараа шууд бус асуулт ордог: “… who had broken the window” (цонхыг хэн хагалсныг); хагалах үйл “knew”-ээс өмнө болсон тул өнгөрсөн төгссөн цагт байна.

items.label: e
items.text: I'll help you with your homework …
items.explanation: “after” цагийн холбоос үгийн дараа ирээдүйн үйлийг одоо энгийн цагаар илэрхийлдэг: “I'll help you with your homework … after I finish dinner” (оройн хоолоо идэж дуусаад).

choices.text: … she could buy a new laptop.
… I would travel around the world.
… I will travel around the world.

tasks.instructions: Choose an appropriate answer for each question. There is one extra answer in column 2. /5 x 1 = 5 points/

items.label: a
items.explanation: Дэлгүүрийн худалдагч “Can I help you?” гэж туслах санал гаргахад худалдан авагч юу хайж байгаагаа хэлдэг: “Yes, I'm looking for a pair of jeans.” (жинсэн өмд хайж байна).

items.label: b
items.explanation: “What time is it?” гэж цаг асуухад “Nearly half past four.” (дөрвөн цаг хагас болох гэж байна) гэж цагийг хэлнэ.

items.label: c
items.explanation: “Whose bag is this?” нь эзэмшигчийг асуудаг тул эзэмшлийн хэлбэртэй “It's Saraa's.” (Сараагийнх) гэсэн хариулт тохирно.

items.label: d
items.explanation: “Have you finished the report?” гэсэн одоо төгссөн цагийн асуултад хараахан дуусаагүй бол “Not yet, sorry.” (хараахан үгүй, уучлаарай) гэж хариулна.

items.label: e
items.explanation: “What do you do?” нь ажил мэргэжлийг асуудаг тул “I'm an accountant.” (нягтлан бодогч); “I'm reading a book.” нь “What are you doing?” гэсэн асуултын хариулт.

choices.text: 'Yes, I'm looking for a pair of jeans.'

tasks.instructions: Read the text and fill in the gaps (a-e) with the appropriate adjectives (1-6). There is one extra adjective. /5 x 1 = 5 points/
tasks.text:
1. adventurous   2. cheerful   3. thoughtful   4. sensitive   5. stubborn   6. hard-working

Can your favourite season say something about you? Some people think so. Those who love summer are usually a) _________. They are always smiling and in a good mood. People who prefer winter are often b) _________; they like to sit quietly and think deeply about life.

Spring lovers tend to be c) _________. They enjoy trying new and exciting things, like travelling to unknown places. People whose favourite season is autumn are d) _________; their feelings are easily hurt. Finally, people who love every season equally are said to be e) _________; they don't mind the weather because they are always busy working.

items.label: a
items.explanation: Зунд дуртай хүмүүсийг “always smiling and in a good mood” (үргэлж инээмсэглэж, сэтгэл санаа сайхан) гэж тодорхойлсон тул “cheerful” (хөгжилтэй, баяр баясгалантай) орно.

items.label: b
items.explanation: “they like to sit quietly and think deeply about life” (чимээгүй суугаад амьдралын тухай гүнзгий бодох дуртай) нь “thoughtful” (бодлогоширсон, гүн бодолтой) хүний шинж.

items.label: c
items.explanation: Хаварт дуртай хүмүүс “enjoy trying new and exciting things, like travelling to unknown places” буюу шинэ, сонирхолтой зүйл туршиж, үл мэдэх газар аялах дуртай тул “adventurous” (адал явдалд дуртай) орно.

items.label: d
items.explanation: “their feelings are easily hurt” (сэтгэл нь амархан гомддог) гэсэн тайлбар нь “sensitive” (мэдрэмтгий, эмзэг) гэсэн үгийн утга.

items.label: e
items.explanation: Бүх улиралд адилхан дуртай хүмүүс “are always busy working” буюу үргэлж ажилдаа завгүй байдаг тул “hard-working” (ажилсаг, хөдөлмөрч); “stubborn” (зөрүүд) нь илүүдэл үг.

tasks.instructions: Read the following report about electric cars. Then choose the correct ending for each sentence. There is one extra ending in column 2. /5 x 1 = 5 points/
tasks.text:
Electric car sales in Eastland

In 2020, only 2 per cent of new cars sold in Eastland were electric. By 2025 this figure had risen to 15 per cent, thanks to lower prices and government payments to buyers.

Experts predict that electric cars will make up 50 per cent of new car sales by 2032. The government plans to stop the sale of new petrol cars completely in 2040.

However, there are still problems. At present, the country has only 3,000 public charging points, and most of them are in the capital. The government has promised to build 20,000 more by 2030, especially along main roads, so that drivers can make long journeys without worrying about their batteries.

items.label: a
items.text: Between 2020 and 2025, the share of electric cars …
items.explanation: 2020 онд “only 2 per cent” байсан цахилгаан машины эзлэх хувь 2025 онд “had risen to 15 per cent” болсон тул “… rose from 2 to 15 per cent”.

items.label: b
items.explanation: Өсөлтийн шалтгааныг “thanks to lower prices and government payments to buyers” гэж заасан тул “The increase was helped by … lower prices and government payments”.

items.label: c
items.text: By 2032, half of all new cars sold …
items.explanation: Мэргэжилтнүүд “electric cars will make up 50 per cent of new car sales by 2032” гэж таамагласан; 50 хувь нь тал тул “… are expected to be electric”.

items.label: d
items.text: The sale of new petrol cars …
items.explanation: Засгийн газар “plans to stop the sale of new petrol cars completely in 2040” гэсэн тул бензинээр явдаг шинэ машины худалдаа “… will end in 2040”.

items.label: e
items.text: Most of the public charging points …
items.explanation: Одоогийн цэнэглэх цэгүүдийн тухай “most of them are in the capital” гэсэн тул “… are in the capital”; гол замын дагуух (“along main roads”) цэгүүдийг харин 2030 он гэхэд шинээр барина.

tasks.title: Listening
tasks.instructions: You are going to listen to a dialogue between a radio presenter and a woman who has sailed alone around the world. For questions 41-46 decide which of the choices A, B, C, D or E is the correct answer. You have 45 seconds to look through the questions before you listen. You will listen twice only, so listen carefully. /6 x 2 = 12 points/
tasks.audioScript:
Presenter: Welcome to 'Brave Voices'. My guest is Lucy Grant, who has just sailed alone around the world. Lucy, congratulations!
Lucy: Thank you very much.
Presenter: How long did the journey take?
Lucy: Two hundred and sixty days. I left from Plymouth, in England, at the end of March and came back in December. I was hoping to finish in two hundred days, but the weather was terrible in the Southern Ocean.
Presenter: What was the most difficult moment?
Lucy: About halfway, south of Australia, a huge wave hit the boat and broke the mast. I couldn't sail properly for days.
Presenter: What did you do?
Lucy: First, I made sure I was safe and the boat wasn't taking in water. Then I sent a message to my support team. They told me how to build a small temporary mast from the broken pieces. It took me three days, but it worked, and I sailed slowly to a port in New Zealand for repairs.
Presenter: Weren't you lonely?
Lucy: Sometimes. I spoke to my family by satellite phone once a week, and I listened to lots of audiobooks. And the albatrosses kept me company. They followed the boat for days!
Presenter: What did you learn?
Lucy: That panic never helps. If you stay calm and solve one problem at a time, you can deal with almost anything.
Presenter: Lucy Grant, thank you.

questions.stem: Lucy's journey took
questions.explanation: Аялал хэр удсан бэ гэхэд Люси “Two hundred and sixty days” гэж хариулсан нь “260 days”; “200 days” бол түүний төлөвлөж байсан хугацаа.

questions.stem: The journey was longer than planned because

options.D: the weather in the Southern Ocean was very bad.

questions.explanation: Люси “I was hoping to finish in two hundred days, but the weather was terrible in the Southern Ocean” гэсэн; “terrible” нь “very bad” гэсэн утгатай тул аялал төлөвлөснөөс уртассан.

questions.stem: South of Australia,

options.A: Lucy saw land for the first time.
options.C: a huge wave broke the boat's mast.

questions.explanation: Люси “About halfway, south of Australia, a huge wave hit the boat and broke the mast” гэж ярьсан тул асар том давалгаа дарвуулын шонг хугалсан.

questions.stem: After the accident, Lucy

options.E: built a temporary mast with advice from her team.

questions.explanation: Люсигийн хэлснээр дэмжлэгийн баг нь “told me how to build a small temporary mast from the broken pieces” буюу хугархай хэсгүүдээс түр шон хийх аргыг зааж өгсөн тул тэр түр шон барьсан; аяллаа орхиогүй.

questions.stem: Lucy spoke to her family
questions.explanation: Люси “I spoke to my family by satellite phone once a week” гэж хэлсэн тул гэр бүлтэйгээ долоо хоногт нэг удаа ярьдаг байжээ.

questions.stem: According to Lucy, the most important lesson is to

options.D: stay calm and solve one problem at a time.

questions.explanation: Сургамжийн тухай Люси “That panic never helps. If you stay calm and solve one problem at a time, you can deal with almost anything” гэжээ; тайван байж, асуудлыг нэг нэгээр нь шийдэх нь хамгийн чухал.
